test_description: Verify offline reading session creation and automatic synchronization upon network restoration
business_risk: Critical - Data loss leads to user churn
preconditions: User logged in; Device in Airplane Mode; Isar DB initialized
test_steps: 1. Disable Network; 2. Add 'ReadingSession' locally; 3. Verify 'pending_sync' flag; 4. Enable Network; 5. Trigger Sync Service; 6. Verify Backend DB record
expected_result: Local record created immediately; Backend record created after sync; Local status updated to 'synced'
dependencies: Isar Database; Connectivity Plus; Backend Sync Endpoint
success_criteria: Data consistency between Local and Remote DBs; No duplicates
cleanup_requirements: Wipe Local DB; Reset Backend User Data
security_considerations: Sync payload must be authenticated via JWT
